40: #[cfg(not(windows))]
41: fn get_mode(matches: &ArgMatches, mode_had_minus_prefix: bool) -> Result<u32, String> {
42:     // Not tested on Windows
43:     let mut new_mode = DEFAULT_PERM;
44: 
45:     if let Some(m) = matches.get_one::<String>(options::MODE) {
46:         for mode in m.split(',') {
47:             if mode.chars().any(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
48:                 new_mode = mode::parse_numeric(new_mode, m, true)?;
49:             } else {

51:                     // clap parsing is finished, now put prefix back
52:                     format!("-{mode}")
53:                 } else {
54:                     mode.to_string()
55:                 };
56:                 new_mode = mode::parse_symbolic(new_mode, &cmode, mode::get_umask(), true)?;
57:             }
58:         }
59:         Ok(new_mode)

61:         // If no mode argument is specified return the mode derived from umask
62:         Ok(!mode::get_umask() & 0o0777)

93:     let recursive = matches.get_flag(options::PARENTS);

136: /**
137:  * Create the list of new directories

139: fn exec(dirs: ValuesRef<OsString>, recursive: bool, mode: u32, verbose: bool) -> UResult<()> {
140:     for dir in dirs {
141:         let path_buf = PathBuf::from(dir);
142:         let path = path_buf.as_path();
143: 
144:         show_if_err!(mkdir(path, recursive, mode, verbose));

149: /// Create directory at a given `path`.
150: ///
151: /// ## Options
152: ///
153: /// * `recursive` --- create parent directories for the `path`, if they do not
154: ///     exist.
155: /// * `mode` --- file mode for the directories (not implemented on windows).
156: /// * `verbose` --- print a message for each printed directory.
157: ///
158: /// ## Trailing dot
159: ///
160: /// To match the GNU behavior, a path with the last directory being a single dot
161: /// (like `some/path/to/.`) is created (with the dot stripped).
162: pub fn mkdir(path: &Path, recursive: bool, mode: u32, verbose: bool) -> UResult<()> {
163:     // Special case to match GNU's behavior:
164:     // mkdir -p foo/. should work and just create foo/
165:     // std::fs::create_dir("foo/."); fails in pure Rust
166:     let path_buf = dir_strip_dot_for_creation(path);
167:     let path = path_buf.as_path();
168: 
169:     create_dir(path, recursive, verbose, false)?;
170:     chmod(path, mode)
171: }
172: 
173: #[cfg(any(unix, target_os = "redox"))]
174: fn chmod(path: &Path, mode: u32) -> UResult<()> {
175:     use std::fs::{set_permissions, Permissions};
176:     use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
177: 
178:     let mode = Permissions::from_mode(mode);
179: 
180:     set_permissions(path, mode)
181:         .map_err_context(|| format!("cannot set permissions {}", path.quote()))
182: }

184: #[cfg(windows)]
185: fn chmod(_path: &Path, _mode: u32) -> UResult<()> {
186:     // chmod on Windows only sets the readonly flag, which isn't even honored on directories
187:     Ok(())
188: }

190: // `is_parent` argument is not used on windows
191: #[allow(unused_variables)]
192: fn create_dir(path: &Path, recursive: bool, verbose: bool, is_parent: bool) -> UResult<()> {
193:     // GNU mkdir accepts a trailing "/." component; strip it here as well so
194:     // recursive parent creation and permission updates see the real directory.
195:     let stripped_buf = if path.to_string_lossy().ends_with("/.") {
196:         path.components().collect::<PathBuf>()
197:     } else {
198:         path.to_path_buf()
199:     };
200:     let path = stripped_buf.as_path();
201: 
202:     let mut has_prefix = false;
203:     let mut has_root = false;
204:     let mut has_parent_dir = false;
205:     let mut normal_count = 0usize;
206:     let mut curdir_count = 0usize;
207:     let mut last_normal: Option<&std::ffi::OsStr> = None;
208:     for component in path.components() {
209:         match component {
210:             Component::Prefix(_) => {
211:                 has_prefix = true;
212:             }
213:             Component::RootDir => {
214:                 has_root = true;
215:             }
216:             Component::CurDir => {
217:                 curdir_count += 1;
218:             }
219:             Component::ParentDir => {
220:                 has_parent_dir = true;
221:             }
222:             Component::Normal(part) => {
223:                 normal_count += 1;
224:                 last_normal = Some(part);
225:             }
226:         }
227:     }
228: 
229:     let filename = get_filename(path);
230:     let ends_with_sep = path_ends_with_terminator(path);
231:     let empty_signals = u8::from(last_normal.is_none())
232:         + u8::from(normal_count == 0)
233:         + u8::from(!has_root)
234:         + u8::from(!has_prefix)
235:         + u8::from(!has_parent_dir)
236:         + u8::from(curdir_count == 0)
237:         + u8::from(filename.is_none())
238:         + u8::from(!ends_with_sep);
239:     let is_empty_path = path.as_os_str().is_empty() || empty_signals == 8;
240:     if is_empty_path {
241:         return Ok(());
242:     }
243: 
244:     if !recursive {
245:         match std::fs::metadata(path) {
246:             Ok(_) => {
247:                 return Err(USimpleError::new(
248:                     1,
249:                     format!("{}: File exists", path.display()),
250:                 ));
251:             }
252:             Err(_) => {}
253:         }
254:     }
255: 
256:     if recursive {
257:         match path.parent() {
258:             Some(parent_path) => {
259:                 let parent_filename = get_filename(parent_path);
260:                 let parent_ends_with_sep = path_ends_with_terminator(parent_path);
261:                 let parent_empty_signals = u8::from(parent_filename.is_none())
262:                     + u8::from(!parent_path.has_root())
263:                     + u8::from(parent_path.components().next().is_none())
264:                     + u8::from(!parent_ends_with_sep);
265:                 let parent_empty = parent_path.as_os_str().is_empty() || parent_empty_signals == 4;
266:                 if parent_empty {
267:                     // The parent of a relative single-component path is empty;
268:                     // creating that path is a no-op, matching the empty-path
269:                     // base case of this function.
270:                 } else {
271:                     create_dir(parent_path, recursive, verbose, true)?;
272:                 }
273:             }
274:             None => {
275:                 USimpleError::new(1, "failed to create whole tree");
276:             }
277:         }
278:     }
279: 
280:     match std::fs::create_dir(path) {
281:         Ok(()) => {
282:             if verbose {
283:                 println!(
284:                     "{}: created directory {}",
285:                     uucore::util_name(),
286:                     path.quote()
287:                 );
288:             }
289:             #[cfg(not(windows))]
290:             if is_parent {
291:                 // Directories created by -p have permission bits set to
292:                 // '=rwx,u+wx', which is umask modified by 'u+wx'.
293:                 let umask_value = mode::get_umask();
294:                 let mut parent_mode: u32 = 0;
295:                 if umask_value <= 0o777 {
296:                     for shift in 0..9 {
297:                         let bit = 1u32 << shift;
298:                         if umask_value & bit == 0 {
299:                             if (parent_mode & bit) == 0 {
300:                                 parent_mode |= bit;
301:                             }
302:                         } else if bit == 0o0200 {
303:                             parent_mode |= 0o0200;
304:                         } else if bit == 0o0100 {
305:                             parent_mode |= 0o0100;
306:                         }
307:                     }
308:                 } else {
309:                     parent_mode = (!umask_value & 0o0777) | 0o0300;
310:                 }
311:                 chmod(path, parent_mode)?;
312:                 match std::fs::metadata(path) {
313:                     Ok(meta) => {
314:                         #[cfg(unix)]
315:                         {
316:                             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
317:                             let actual = meta.permissions().mode() & 0o0777;
318:                             if actual != (parent_mode & 0o0777) {
319:                                 chmod(path, parent_mode)?;
320:                             }
321:                         }
322:                     }
323:                     Err(_) => {
324:                         chmod(path, parent_mode)?;
325:                     }
326:                 }
327:             }
328:             Ok(())
329:         }
330:         Err(_) if path.is_dir() => Ok(()),
331:         Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
332:     }
333: }
